mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the average 20d return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.3 million units signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0, or the average 60d return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger a hawkish Fed stance, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 2.4%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.8%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a robust economic cycle that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
